threshold_rule: max(0, 99th percentile of all validation actual-minus-expected residuals); strictly greater
training: Jan-Jun 2016, per-building fit; validation Jul-Dec 2016; test Jan-Dec 2017
expectation: Uses weather and measured electricity at same hour 168 hours earlier; not a week-ahead forecast.
limitations: US public BDG2 data, not UAE validation.
Thelma was selected after exploring three buildings.
No ground-truth faults: alert precision and false-alarm rate are unknown.
Review candidates, not confirmed waste, savings or independent events.
No retraining after validation. Residual threshold may drift with building use.
A low-use prior-week holiday can depress lag-based expectations the following week.
snapshot_note: Reproduced from the original checked model on 2026-10-28; original model and review rule unchanged.
